shortcut_probes.subgroup: q-104300 with positive scalar and positive-derivative trig (sin/tan)
shortcut_probes.strategy: choose the unique sum option when every other option includes subtraction
shortcut_probes.conclusion: 4/4 conditional matches versus five-choice baseline 0.2. Inspecting the bank shows that this is derivative-sign elimination: positive power factor and sin/tan have positive derivative contributions for positive x in a regular interval. Cosine reverses the trig derivative sign; negative coefficients reverse it again. This uses mathematical derivative signs, not a label/position cue. It does not establish complete calculation mastery.

delivery.result: 143 ->114 samples, runner5->5, counterfactual17->16. Decision roles survive every examined stage when easy has positive selection weight; no role-specific resampling.
